description: This file provides functions and types for discarding unknown fields in Protocol Buffer messages, including recursive discarding for legacy and proto2 messages, with internal mechanisms for managing discard information.

classes.name: discardInfo
classes.description: Holds metadata for discarding unknown fields of a specific message type, including type info, field info, and unrecognized field offset.

classes.name: discardFieldInfo
classes.description: Stores information about a specific field's offset and discard function for unknown field handling.

classes.name: discardLegacy
classes.description: Legacy function to discard unknown fields in older message implementations.

methods.name: DiscardUnknown
methods.description: Public function to discard all unknown fields from a message, handling both legacy and current message types.

methods.name: DiscardUnknown (method on InternalMessageInfo)
methods.description: Recursively discards unknown fields for a specific message instance.

methods.name: getDiscardInfo
methods.description: Retrieves or creates discardInfo metadata for a given reflect.Type.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Performs the actual discarding of unknown fields based on stored metadata.

methods.name: computeDiscardInfo
methods.description: Analyzes a message type to populate discardInfo with field discard functions.
